prompt: query values that are undefined end up in the URL as the text 'undefined': inject(dispatch, { url: '/', query: { a: undefined, b: 1 } }) requests /?a=undefined&b=1. Leave undefined values out of the query string, including undefined entries inside array values.
requirement: When query is an object, keys whose value is undefined are omitted from the request URL (they neither add nor replace a parameter), and undefined elements of an array value are skipped. Other values (including null, 0, '' and false) are serialized as before. String queries are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: an undefined value does not remove a parameter already in the url
null, 0 and '' are still serialized as before

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)
provenance.notes: Real behaviour of light-my-request v6.6.0 (searchParams.set(key, undefined)).
